Appreciate the context and the RFP. High level response and next steps below — we can set a 30-minute call to walk Finance through the activation flow if helpful.

Quick answers:
- We can do 12 or 24 month private offers; PAYG pricing available but typically higher unit cost.
- Proration: yes — private offers can include proration rules (start/prorate to month). We'll note how we handle partial quarters.
- Buyer approvals: the common flow is Procurement -> Finance -> Legal. For faster activation we can accept an authorized procurement email (with PO) and route final signature to Finance within 48 hours.

1) Share a concise checklist (buyer gating + evidence list) 
2) Draft a private-offer PDF for your review (pricing scenarios) — attached v1
3) Loop in Sales Ops (Naomi) to confirm activation SLA and DocuSign path

Best,

Susan / Mateo —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick operational checklist and recommended gating to keep activation under 72 hours once we have buyer intent: 

Operational checklist (what HealthGrid should provide to move fast):
- Signed PO or procurement email with authorized spend owner (procurement@healthgrid.com acceptable)
- Billing contact + legal contact (name, email)
- Confirmation of desired term (12mo or 24mo) and commit level (estimated monthly $)
- SOC2 report / security questionnaire to attach to the HubSpot deal (we use this for internal approval)

Redwood recommended activation path (low friction):
1) Procurement confirms PO or signed acceptance (Procurement -> Finance)
2) Finance emails activation approval to salesops@redwood.ai (we accept signed PO or finance authorizer email)
3) Redwood issues private offer in AWS Marketplace and sends DocuSign for final signature (Legal signoff concurrent)

Notes: we can include a 30-day trial activation window in the private offer if you want an initial pilot period; proration can be set to calendar-month alignment (we'll show options in the draft).

I've attached our activation_playbook (internal but safe to share) and the HubSpot link for the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1045-Redwood/DEAL-5267

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales Operations, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Mateo/Team —

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of constraints from our side that will affect routing and term:

- Our CFO (Mark) will only sign off on multi-year commitments with quarterly financial reviews; if we go 24-months we need proration and an early-termination clause tied to performance SLAs.
- Procurement wants SOC2 + a short data-processing addendum before Legal will sign. Can Redwood provide a DPA template?
- Our procurement cycle is tight this month; if we can shorten the activation path to Procurement -> Finance (skip Legal signoff before activation, Legal reviews the DocuSign concurrently) we may be able to start in April.

Quote from Naomi's note below for clarity: 
> "Redwood recommended activation path (low friction): Procurement -> Finance -> Legal"

Can you confirm whether Redwood is comfortable with activation on Procurement+Finance alone and Legal concurrent review? Also, can you provide a sample private-offer draft that includes: 12mo price, 24mo discounted price, proration rules, and an SLA-linked early-termination clause?

Thanks,
Susan

Procurement Ops: procurement@healthgrid.com

Thanks for the specifics — we can accommodate the activation flow you outlined. Final proposal summary below (we'll generate the official AWS private-offer via the Hub once you confirm).

Proposal summary (short):
- Recommended initial term: 12 months with option to extend to 24 months at a pre-negotiated discount band
- Pricing: 12mo list $X per unit (PAYG rate if chosen + 18% uplift); 24mo committed diskount 15% off list
- Proration: monthly proration to calendar month; we will include pro rata calculation in the PO draft
- Early-termination: SLA-linked termination clause (90-day remedy window + proportional refund on unused pre-paid portion) — draft language in attached PO draft
- Activation path: Procurement (PO/email) -> Finance (approval email to salesops@redwood.ai) — Legal to review DocuSign concurrently. We will not hold activation for Legal signature as long as Finance confirms approval; Legal can condition a later signature for contract completeness.

2) If Procurement can send an authorized email or PO, Naomi will trigger the AWS private offer within 48–72 hours.
3) Vanessa will share the evidence pack (SOC2, DPA template) to procurement@healthgrid.com by end of day.
